scope: Numerical verification against independent analytical references; no physical validation.

protocol.status: fixed protocol; solver and reference verification pending
protocol.mode: one-phase melting; initially solid at 310 K; left wall 330 K; insulated far wall
protocol.regularization: solidus=310 K; liquidus=310 K+width; initial liquid fraction zero
protocol.front_definition: linear interpolation of liquid fraction=0.5 at cell centers; undefined crossing reported explicitly
protocol.separation: vary mesh only at dt=0.0625 s and width=0.125 K; vary dt only at N=800 and width=0.125 K; vary width only at N=800 and dt=0.0625 s; check finite-domain effect by doubling length at fixed dx
protocol.acceptance: maximum relative front error <=0.02 over all positive observation times at final settings; investigate failure without selecting favorable times or silently retuning

heat.spatial_policy: Exact semidiscrete evolution versus continuum cell averages; no time error.
